name: NeedleBench V2
intro: NeedleBench V2是评估大型语言模型在不同信息密度下进行长上下文检索与推理的合成框架。信息稀疏分支在中英文干草文本中插入虚构单针或多针，信息密集的祖先追溯挑战则用连续亲属关系构造2至512条针；官方配置覆盖4k至1,000k上下文。
build_method: 程序化合成, 长上下文插入, 受控任务生成
metric: 关键词感知精确匹配, 加权准确率, ENL-50
task_type: 长上下文检索, 多步推理, 祖先追溯
eval_feature: 信息稀疏与信息密集, 4k–1,000k, ATC, 双语
task_type_en: Long-context Retrieval, Multi-step Reasoning, Ancestral Trace
build_method_en: Programmatic Synthesis, Long-context Insertion, Controlled Task Generation
eval_feature_en: Information-sparse and Dense Tasks, 4k–1,000k, ATC, Bilingual
intro_en: NeedleBench V2 is a synthetic framework for evaluating long-context retrieval and reasoning at different information densities. Its sparse branch inserts fictional single or multiple needles into English and Chinese haystacks, while the information-dense Ancestral Trace Challenge constructs continuous kinship chains with 2 to 512 needles; official configurations span 4k to 1,000k contexts.
metric_en: Keyword-aware Exact Match, Weighted Accuracy, ENL-50

    E["Generate test instances across multiple context lengths, needle depths, and repetitions for each task type"] --> F["Evaluate model predictions using keyword-aware Exact Match, awarding full credit if any predefined keyword appears"]
    F["Evaluate model predictions using keyword-aware Exact Match, awarding full credit if any predefined keyword appears"] --> G["Average the three sparse tasks equally and report ATC weighted accuracy with ENL-50 separately"]

drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2407.11963 Sections 3.1-3.2 and Appendices E-G, plus the official OpenCompass NeedleBench V2 configuration README. The diagram separates information-sparse S-RT, M-RT, and fictional-kinship M-RS from the information-dense Ancestral Trace Challenge. It records English PaulGrahamEssays and ChineseDomainModelingEval haystacks, 2-5 fact kinship needles, 10 repetitions, 4k through 1,000k context configurations, ATC powers-of-two from 2 to 512 needles, keyword-aware exact match for sparse tasks, and boxed exact match with needle-count weighting and ENL-50 for ATC.
